alex: quick ping — PR #8214 is ready but windows-e2e keeps timing out on CI. passes locally for me. can someone take a quick look?
ci-bot: GitHub Actions · build-and-test · PR #8214 — windows-e2e FAILED (timeout). job id: 4827. https://ci.redwood.internal/4827/logs
maria: on it, grabbing the logs now
simon: do you have a direct link to the failing test? windows teardown flakes a lot.
alex: yep, logs above. failing test is `test_node_shutdown_timeout` in tests/e2e/connection_test.py. locally `pytest -k connection_test::test_node_shutdown_timeout -q` passes 5/5. my patch is a tiny retry around node.stop().
alex: snippet:
```python
# retry on TimeoutError to reduce flakiness in CI
for _ in range(3):
    try:
        node.stop()
        break
    except TimeoutError:
        time.sleep(0.1 * (2 ** _))
```
maria: that change looks reasonable. do you want me to trigger a rerun or do you have permissions?
alex: I don't have permissions to re-run the windows matrix, would appreciate a rerun.
devops: rerun-requested by maria — job 4827 rerun queued (windows-e2e)
ci-bot: windows-e2e (rerun #1) started
ci-bot: windows-e2e PASSED — all checks green for PR #8214
simon: lgtm. tiny nit: maybe call the multiplier `base_sleep` or add a comment explaining 0.1 as base, but not blocking.
maria: approved and merged by maria — merged into main to unblock dedicated autoscale e2e job :shipit:
alex: thanks all :raised_hands:
simon: created follow-up ticket #8320 to extract a small retry util and add unit tests for it
alex: noted, thanks — will pick up the follow-up if no objections
